items.question: Will the photos still look like me?
items.answer: That is what your 4–6 reference selfies are for. UnrealShot keeps one identity across all 60 photos. A small amount of drift can happen in individual frames, which is why every pack includes 15 Photo Retakes.

items.answer: Because that is what a real camera roll looks like. Each shoot moves from a close portrait to half-body, full-length, and candid. The place, clothes, and light stay consistent while the framing and action change.

items.answer: The shoots are written around real focal lengths, specific light directions, and phone-plausible framing. Every frame contains one person—you—so there are no filler crowds or background faces to give the image away.

items.question: Do I have to write prompts or plan the shoots?

items.answer: Use one of the 15 included Photo Retakes. The replacement stays inside the original shoot, so it still matches the other three frames instead of becoming a random one-off.

items.question: What exactly is included for $39?

Dating apps reward natural lighting, authentic skin texture, realistic clothing wrinkles, and candid unposed moments. That required a completely new engine architecture.

Plus, we included 15 individual Photo Retakes with every order so you can replace any single frame without rebuilding your entire camera roll.
